instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Extend the theme with the colors and fonts defined above. Add 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' to font families.
2. UPDATE INDEX.CSS: Replace the root variables with the 'css_variables' provided in the colors section. This is CRITICAL for the theme to work.
3. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import for Playfair Display and Manrope to index.css or index.html.
4. COMPONENT STYLING: When using Shadcn components, override the default sharp corners with 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-full' as specified.
5. LAYOUT: Use the 'marketing' grid for the homepage. Avoid simple single-column layouts. Create visual interest with asymmetrical grids.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text on the 'Terracotta' primary color is white. Ensure text on 'Bone White' background is 'Charcoal' or darker.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold with spacing and typography.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds; use solid warm colors or subtle textures.
Ensure mobile responsiveness for all grids (grid-cols-1 on mobile).
